title: Sprint 14 Planning
raw_text:
Sarah: Sprint 14 planning. After thinking about it over the weekend, I want to make technical debt the top priority this sprint. The ORM migration cannot wait any longer.

Lina: Hold on. Last week we agreed notifications are the top priority. I already wrote the requirements. Two enterprise clients are waiting.

Sarah: I understand, but if the backend is fragile, shipping notifications on a broken foundation is worse. Tech debt first, notifications in Sprint 15.

Lina: The clients were promised a demo by May 1.

Sarah: We will push the demo to May 15. I will talk to sales.

Karim: I agree with Sarah. The raw SQL situation is getting dangerous. I will lead the ORM migration. I estimate two weeks.

Sarah: Good. Karim owns the ORM migration. Deadline is May 2.

Youssef: What about search? Last meeting you told me to wait for sprint planning. Should I start the prototype now?

Sarah: Yes, go ahead. Start the search prototype this sprint. It is a small task and does not conflict with the ORM work.

Youssef: I will have a working prototype by April 30.

Lina: I am concerned about the client communication. Who tells them about the delay?

Sarah: I will handle it personally. Meeting adjourned.
